_about: Hand-transcribed Gogma Artian weapon mechanics (TU4, Dec 2025). Base stat variants per focus live in gogma_weapons_base.json (from wilds.mhdb.io). Sources: monsterhunterwiki.org/wiki/Gogma_Artian_Weapons_(MHWilds), monsterhunterwiki.org/wiki/Artian_Weapons_(MHWilds), game8 archives/571311, fextralife Gogma_Artian_Weapons, nixzxin.com/guides/gogma-weapon-mechanics. All element numbers are DISPLAY values (true element = display / 10).

how_it_works.base: Upgrade a Rarity-8 Artian weapon (3 Artian parts, R8 base raw 190 true / affinity +5%) at the Smithy with Gogmazios materials (Tarred Devices).
how_it_works.parts_bonus: Each of the 3 Artian parts carries an Artian Bonus: either +5 true attack or +5% affinity. So the part bonuses add 0..15 attack and 15..0 affinity in 5-point steps (3 parts total).
how_it_works.element_from_parts: Element comes from the parts' element. If all 3 parts share the element you get an Element Infusion (+30 display element for most types, +20 for SnS/DB/SA/IG/Bow). Rarity-8 base element values are in artian_r8_element_display below.
how_it_works.focus: On upgrade you pick one permanent Focus: attack / affinity / element. Stat deltas are in focus_delta below and are already baked into the three API variants in gogma_weapons_base.json (raw 200/-10%, 180/+15%, 190/0%).
how_it_works.set_and_group_skill: Every Gogma Artian weapon rolls ONE Set Bonus skill and ONE Group skill at random (reroll via 'Reset Skills' with Tarred Devices + zenny). The weapon then COUNTS AS ONE EQUIPPED PIECE for that set bonus and that group skill (e.g. weapon + 1 armor piece = 2-piece tier, weapon + 3 armor = 4-piece; weapon + 2 armor with the same group skill = group skill active). Piece-count behaviour confirmed in game by the user (2026-10-06).
how_it_works.skill_pool: CONFIRMED from game data (ArtianSkillGroupData, see gogma_skill_pool.json): 21 set bonuses x 14 group skills = 294 (set, group) pairs, all weight 1 (uniform). Excluded: the four festival Prayers (Blossomdance/Flamefete/Dreamspell/Lumenhymn), Festival Spirit, Glory's Favor, Master of the Fist. P(specific set bonus) = 1/21, P(specific group skill) = 1/14.
how_it_works.reinforcements: The weapon keeps the 5 Artian reinforcement bonuses from its base; Gogma Reinforce raises each to II / III / EX (Keep Bonus) or rerolls all 5 (Reset Bonus). Limit: max 2 reinforcements of the exact same type+level (so at most 2x Attack EX). Values in reinforcement_values below.
how_it_works.slots: All 14 Gogma Artian weapons have three level-3 weapon decoration slots [3,3,3].
how_it_works.innate_skills: None. Weapon skills come only from the 3 weapon decoration slots (plus charm/weapon-kind decorations).

focus_delta._columns: attack (true raw), affinity (%), element (display). '-' in the wiki = no change. Affinity focus also shifts sharpness (API variant shows blue 70 / white 10 instead of blue 30 / white 20).

hunting-horn.element: Echo Bubble: Defense & Elemental Res Up

focus_mechanic_changes.light-bowgun: Ammo LV/capacity/rapid-fire changes per focus (see API 'ammo' field per variant)
focus_mechanic_changes.heavy-bowgun: Ammo LV/capacity changes per focus (see API 'ammo' field per variant)

artian_r8_element_display._about: Base element of a Rarity-8 Artian weapon by element group, DISPLAY values (monsterhunterwiki Artian page). Status values are buildup, not element. Infusion bonus applies when all 3 parts share the element.

reinforcement_values._about: 5 reinforcement bonuses per weapon. CONFIRMED from game data (ArtianBonusData / ArtianBonusCategoryData in dtlnor/MHWs-in-json). Level I = regular Artian grinding bonus; Gogma Reinforce rolls II / III / EX (EX flagged rare, sub-probability 80 vs 50). Attack is true raw; affinity %; element is DISPLAY (datamine stores true = display/10); sharpness is gauge points; ammo is capacity.

element_by_type._columns: DISPLAY element. Level I from the datamine (same as regular Artian element bonus); II and EX from the datamine (match the wiki); no Level III exists for element.

reinforcement_values.stacking_limit: no more than 2 bonuses of the exact same type AND level (e.g. 2x Attack EX max); 5 EX of mixed types is possible (wiki); datamine caps a category at 5 slots (sharpness/ammo at 2)

best_case_examples.raw: 2x Attack EX (+24) + 2x Affinity EX (+20%) + 1x Attack III (+9) = +33 attack, +20% affinity
best_case_examples.element_gs: 2x Element EX (+220) + 2x Attack EX (+24) + Affinity EX (+10%)
